{{Top|leg}}
'''''S-71''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lamba-shuttle]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

It was carrying a delegation for [[Airam Clans|Airam]] [[Clan leader]] [[Ilay]] to board with the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|Dreadnaught]] to make new negotiations. During this meeting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] to [[Battle of Aiqin 4|capture]] Ilay. The shuttle was likely destroyed in the skirmish.
